schema.text: What difficulties do you experience when combining different transport modes (e.g. bike + public transport, car + metro, walking + bus)?

options.text: Vehicles are too crowded (e.g. no space for a bicycle, pushchair, wheelchair or luggage)
Poor coordination between modes (long waiting times, missed connections)
Lack of infrastructure (e.g. no bicycle parking or no bicycle access on public transport)
Complicated transfers (stations far apart, unclear routes)
The stop or station is hard to reach on foot (no pavement, stairs, difficult crossings)
Cost is too high when combining modes
Services are infrequent or do not run in the evening
Physical effort is too high (e.g. carrying a bicycle or walking long distances)
I do not experience significant difficulties

it.#What difficulties do you experience whe: Quali difficoltà incontri nel combinare diversi mezzi di trasporto (ad es. bicicletta + trasporto pubblico, auto + metro, a piedi + autobus)?
it.#Poor coordination between modes (long w: Scarso coordinamento tra i mezzi (lunghi tempi di attesa, coincidenze perse)
it.#Lack of infrastructure (e.g. no bicycle: Mancanza di infrastrutture (ad es. parcheggi per biciclette o accesso delle biciclette al trasporto pubblico)
it.#Complicated transfers (stations far apa: Cambi complicati (stazioni distanti tra loro, percorsi poco chiari)
it.#Cost is too high when combining modes: Il costo è troppo elevato quando si combinano più mezzi
it.#Safety concerns (traffic, theft, unsafe: Preoccupazioni per la sicurezza (traffico, furti, zone poco sicure)
it.#Physical effort is too high (e.g. carry: Lo sforzo fisico è troppo elevato (ad es. trasportare una bicicletta o camminare per lunghe distanze)
it.#Accessibility issues (stairs, no elevat: Problemi di accessibilità (scale, assenza di ascensori ecc.)
it.#Vehicles are too crowded (e.g. no space: I mezzi sono troppo affollati (ad es. non c’è spazio per bicicletta, passeggino, carrozzina o bagagli)
it.#The stop or station is hard to reach on: La fermata o la stazione è difficile da raggiungere a piedi (marciapiede assente, scale, attraversamenti difficili)
it.#Services are infrequent or do not run i: Le corse sono rare o assenti la sera

fr.#What difficulties do you experience whe: Quelles difficultés rencontrez-vous lorsque vous combinez différents modes de transport, par exemple vélo + transports publics, voiture + métro ou marche + bus ?
fr.#Poor coordination between modes (long w: Mauvaise coordination entre les modes (longues attentes, correspondances manquées)
fr.#Lack of infrastructure (e.g. no bicycle: Manque d’infrastructures (par ex. pas de stationnement vélo ou vélo non autorisé dans les transports publics)
fr.#Complicated transfers (stations far apa: Correspondances compliquées (stations éloignées, itinéraires peu clairs)
fr.#Travel time becomes too long: Le temps de trajet devient trop long
fr.#Cost is too high when combining modes: Le coût est trop élevé quand plusieurs modes sont combinés
fr.#Safety concerns (traffic, theft, unsafe: Problèmes de sécurité (trafic, vol, zones peu sûres)
fr.#Physical effort is too high (e.g. carry: L’effort physique est trop important (par ex. porter un vélo ou marcher longtemps)
fr.#I do not experience significant difficu: Je ne rencontre pas de difficulté importante
fr.#Vehicles are too crowded (e.g. no space: Les véhicules sont trop bondés (par exemple pas de place pour un vélo, une poussette, un fauteuil roulant ou des bagages)
fr.#The stop or station is hard to reach on: L’arrêt ou la gare est difficile à atteindre à pied (pas de trottoir, escaliers, traversées difficiles)
fr.#Services are infrequent or do not run i: Les passages sont rares ou inexistants le soir

de.#What difficulties do you experience whe: Welche Schwierigkeiten haben Sie, wenn Sie verschiedene Verkehrsmittel kombinieren, zum Beispiel Fahrrad + öffentlicher Verkehr, Auto + U-Bahn oder zu Fuß + Bus?
de.#Poor coordination between modes (long w: Schlechte Abstimmung zwischen Verkehrsmitteln (lange Wartezeiten, verpasste Anschlüsse)
de.#Lack of infrastructure (e.g. no bicycle: Fehlende Infrastruktur (z. B. keine Fahrradabstellplätze oder Fahrräder dürfen nicht mitgenommen werden)
de.#Complicated transfers (stations far apa: Kompliziertes Umsteigen (Haltestellen weit auseinander, unklare Wege)
de.#Travel time becomes too long: Die gesamte Fahrzeit wird zu lang
de.#Cost is too high when combining modes: Die Kosten sind beim Kombinieren mehrerer Verkehrsmittel zu hoch
de.#Physical effort is too high (e.g. carry: Der körperliche Aufwand ist zu hoch (z. B. Fahrrad tragen oder lange Strecken zu Fuß gehen)
de.#Accessibility issues (stairs, no elevat: Probleme mit der Barrierefreiheit (Treppen, keine Aufzüge usw.)
de.#Vehicles are too crowded (e.g. no space: Die Fahrzeuge sind zu voll (z. B. kein Platz für Fahrrad, Kinderwagen, Rollstuhl oder Gepäck)
de.#The stop or station is hard to reach on: Die Haltestelle oder der Bahnhof ist zu Fuß schwer erreichbar (kein Gehweg, Treppen, schwierige Querungen)
de.#Services are infrequent or do not run i: Die Verbindungen sind selten oder fahren abends nicht

tr.#What difficulties do you experience whe: Farklı ulaşım seçeneklerini birleştirirken ne tür güçlükler yaşıyorsunuz? Örneğin bisiklet + toplu taşıma, otomobil + metro veya yürüme + otobüs.
tr.#Poor coordination between modes (long w: Ulaşım seçenekleri arasında kötü koordinasyon var (uzun bekleme süreleri, kaçırılan bağlantılar)
tr.#Lack of infrastructure (e.g. no bicycle: Altyapı eksik (ör. bisiklet parkı yok veya toplu taşımaya bisikletle binilemiyor)
tr.#Complicated transfers (stations far apa: Aktarmalar karmaşık (istasyonlar birbirinden uzak, güzergâhlar belirsiz)
tr.#Cost is too high when combining modes: Farklı ulaşım seçeneklerini birleştirince maliyet çok yüksek oluyor
tr.#Safety concerns (traffic, theft, unsafe: Güvenlikle ilgili kaygılar (trafik, hırsızlık, güvensiz bölgeler)
tr.#Physical effort is too high (e.g. carry: Fiziksel çaba çok fazla (ör. bisikleti taşımak veya uzun mesafe yürümek)
tr.#Vehicles are too crowded (e.g. no space: Araçlar çok kalabalık (örneğin bisiklet, bebek arabası, tekerlekli sandalye veya bagaj için yer yok)
tr.#The stop or station is hard to reach on: Durağa veya istasyona yürüyerek ulaşmak zor (kaldırım yok, merdivenler, zor geçitler)
tr.#Services are infrequent or do not run i: Seferler seyrek veya akşamları hiç yok

fa.#What difficulties do you experience whe: هنگام ترکیب روش‌های مختلف رفت‌وآمد، مثلاً دوچرخه + حمل‌ونقل عمومی، خودرو + مترو یا پیاده‌روی + اتوبوس، با چه مشکلاتی روبه‌رو می‌شوید؟
fa.#Poor coordination between modes (long w: هماهنگی بین روش‌ها ضعیف است (انتظار طولانی، از دست دادن وسیله بعدی)
fa.#Lack of infrastructure (e.g. no bicycle: زیرساخت کافی نیست (مثلاً پارک دوچرخه وجود ندارد یا بردن دوچرخه در حمل‌ونقل عمومی ممکن نیست)
fa.#Complicated transfers (stations far apa: تعویض وسیله پیچیده است (ایستگاه‌ها از هم دورند، مسیرها نامشخص‌اند)
fa.#Travel time becomes too long: زمان کل سفر خیلی طولانی می‌شود
fa.#Cost is too high when combining modes: هزینه ترکیب چند روش خیلی زیاد است
fa.#Safety concerns (traffic, theft, unsafe: نگرانی‌های ایمنی و امنیتی (ترافیک، سرقت، مناطق ناامن)
fa.#Lack of reliable information (schedules: اطلاعات قابل اعتماد کافی نیست (زمان‌بندی، تأخیر)
fa.#Physical effort is too high (e.g. carry: تلاش جسمی خیلی زیاد است (مثلاً حمل دوچرخه یا پیاده‌روی طولانی)
fa.#Accessibility issues (stairs, no elevat: مشکلات دسترس‌پذیری (پله، نبود آسانسور و غیره)
fa.#Vehicles are too crowded (e.g. no space: وسایل نقلیه بیش از حد شلوغ‌اند (مثلاً جایی برای دوچرخه، کالسکه، ویلچر یا چمدان نیست)
fa.#The stop or station is hard to reach on: رسیدن پیاده به ایستگاه دشوار است (نبود پیاده‌رو، پله، گذرگاه‌های دشوار)
fa.#Services are infrequent or do not run i: سرویس‌ها کم‌تعدادند یا عصرها و شب‌ها کار نمی‌کنند

hu.#What difficulties do you experience whe: Milyen nehézségeket tapasztal különböző közlekedési módok kombinálásakor, például kerékpár + tömegközlekedés, autó + metró vagy gyaloglás + busz?
hu.#Poor coordination between modes (long w: Gyenge az összehangolás a közlekedési módok között (hosszú várakozás, lekésett csatlakozás)
hu.#Lack of infrastructure (e.g. no bicycle: Hiányos az infrastruktúra (pl. nincs kerékpárparkoló vagy nem lehet kerékpárt vinni a tömegközlekedésre)
hu.#Complicated transfers (stations far apa: Bonyolult az átszállás (az állomások messze vannak egymástól, az útvonalak nem egyértelműek)
hu.#Travel time becomes too long: Az utazási idő túl hosszú lesz
hu.#Cost is too high when combining modes: Túl magas a költség több közlekedési mód kombinálásakor
hu.#Safety concerns (traffic, theft, unsafe: Biztonsági problémák (forgalom, lopás, nem biztonságos területek)
hu.#Physical effort is too high (e.g. carry: Túl nagy a fizikai megterhelés (pl. kerékpár cipelése vagy hosszú gyaloglás)
hu.#Vehicles are too crowded (e.g. no space: A járművek túlzsúfoltak (például nincs hely kerékpárnak, babakocsinak, kerekesszéknek vagy csomagnak)
hu.#The stop or station is hard to reach on: A megálló vagy állomás gyalog nehezen érhető el (nincs járda, lépcsők, nehéz átkelés)
hu.#Services are infrequent or do not run i: Ritkán járnak a járatok, vagy este nem közlekednek

ar.#What difficulties do you experience whe: ما الصعوبات التي تواجهها عند الجمع بين وسائل تنقل مختلفة، مثل الدراجة + النقل العام، السيارة + المترو، أو المشي + الحافلة؟
ar.#Poor coordination between modes (long w: ضعف التنسيق بين الوسائل (انتظار طويل، فقدان وسيلة الربط)
ar.#Lack of infrastructure (e.g. no bicycle: نقص البنية التحتية (مثل عدم وجود موقف للدراجات أو عدم السماح بالدراجة في النقل العام)
ar.#Complicated transfers (stations far apa: التبديل بين الوسائل معقد (المحطات بعيدة عن بعضها، الطرق غير واضحة)
ar.#Cost is too high when combining modes: التكلفة مرتفعة جدًا عند الجمع بين عدة وسائل
ar.#Safety concerns (traffic, theft, unsafe: مخاوف تتعلق بالأمان والسلامة (حركة المرور، السرقة، مناطق غير آمنة)
ar.#Physical effort is too high (e.g. carry: الجهد البدني مرتفع جدًا (مثل حمل الدراجة أو المشي لمسافات طويلة)
ar.#Accessibility issues (stairs, no elevat: مشكلات في سهولة الوصول (سلالم، عدم وجود مصعد، وغيرها)
ar.#Vehicles are too crowded (e.g. no space: وسائل النقل مزدحمة جدًا (مثلًا لا مكان لدراجة أو عربة أطفال أو كرسي متحرك أو أمتعة)
ar.#The stop or station is hard to reach on: يصعب الوصول إلى المحطة سيرًا على الأقدام (لا يوجد رصيف، درج، معابر صعبة)
ar.#Services are infrequent or do not run i: الرحلات قليلة أو لا تعمل في المساء
